challengePass.question: what further actionability change would materially improve Ferrum without speculative framework emulation?
challengePass.reason: click/fill enabled/stable/receives-events convergence is promising, but there is no reproduced current Ferrum failure proving which generic semantics should be imposed across raw WebDriver providers; a larger layer now could hide provider errors.
challengePass.nextExperiment: controlled remote-WebDriver fixture where an element exists before becoming enabled/clickable, compared with classic WebDriver, Playwright and Puppeteer

guardrails: No reduced target coverage, skipped runtime proof, quality/fidelity loss, diagnostic loss, caps, stale caching or weaker tests.
Retry logic consumes only the existing step deadline and never silently extends budgets.
Locator recovery and fixed-alias identity remain distinct so stale fixed elements fail truthfully.
